activity_summary: Kettleby called from Somerset House on the Sabbath and asked pardon for himself, not for his lord. Sir Edward Hoby has written this day to bid the company to supper on Tuesday at Canon Row, after supper, with the king play. It is not at court. It is a gentleman's parlour, and the gentleman is my lord's daughter's husband. Sir Edward desires the play whole. You repeated the word. You are to come by water at five. Twelve sit at table, in a small room. You asked whether my lord knows whose guest it is. Kettleby said my lord knows whose house it is.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Repeated the word, asked whose guest, and did not advise himself.

entities.name: Ambrose Kettleby
entities.context: Called from Somerset House, refused the court, and kept the guest unnamed.

facets.activity: Heard Sir Edward's summons to Canon Row

quotes.speaker: ambrose_kettleby
quotes.text: Master Shakespeare? Kettleby. From Somerset House, and on the Sabbath, for which I ask your pardon and not my lord's.

quotes.speaker: ambrose_kettleby
quotes.text: My lord said not at court. This is a gentleman's parlour, behind a gentleman's door, and the gentleman is his daughter's husband.

quotes.speaker: ambrose_kettleby
quotes.text: Sir Edward has heard there is more of the play than Shoreditch has been let see. He desires it whole.

quotes.speaker: ambrose_kettleby
quotes.text: I repeat a word; I do not advise upon it. Come by water at five. Twelve at table, and a small room.

quotes.speaker: ambrose_kettleby
quotes.text: My lord knows whose house it is. God keep you.
